# Solaris Engineering

Solaris Engineering is a Romania-based B2B firm delivering:
- Photovoltaic (solar PV) installations (residential and industrial)
- Industrial roofing (TPO membrane, metal sheet, metal tiles)
- Modern construction works and metal facades
- Metal parapets and specialized repairs
- Technical maintenance for renewable energy systems

## Business Context
Solaris Engineering focuses on physical infrastructure and energy independence. While the ecosystem includes a utility token (CET) for community engagement, the primary identity is a professional engineering firm. Avoid "DeFi" or "investment" terminology.
